rounds.title: Form field controls
rounds.note: Declares the form field's controls so design complete can check them: field hover, press and focus for a text input and a textarea. The pressed look follows the select (Q56 b).

a.note: The field border darkens one step while pressed, as on the select. A small CSS rule in the part; differs from focus.

hold.until: a text-field control kind in design complete, a textarea mock in @ethlete/components/design/form-field, and a call on the error state's danger contrast
